outgoing.name: Democracy
outgoing.excerpt: Drug trafficking has led to corruption, which has had a deleterious effect on Mexico's democracy.

outgoing.name: United Nations
outgoing.excerpt: The United Nations estimates that nearly 90% of cocaine sold in the United States originates in South America and is smuggled through Mexico.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: Mexican drug trafficking rings play a major role in the flow of cocaine, heroin, and marijuana transiting between Latin America and the United States.
